PNLA.description: Plane Load (PNLA). A static plane load applied to plate or solid elements; ELEM_TYPE selects the element family (PLATE vs SOLID) and SELECT_TYPE selects how target elements are gathered, together driving which optional fields (FACE_NO, ELEM_GROUP, bDEFINE_NODE, CONNECT_NODE) are meaningful.

LCNAME.description: Load Case Name of the static load case this plane load belongs to.

LOAD_GROUP.description: Load Group Name. Optional; if empty, the load is not assigned to a load group.

PNLD_KEY.description: Plane Load Type Key referencing a defined plane-load type (PNLD) entry.

ELEM_TYPE.description: Element Type (case-insensitive). PLATE = plate elements, SOLID = solid elements. Drives applicability of FACE_NO (SOLID) and bDEFINE_NODE/CONNECT_NODE (PLATE).

POINT_ORIGIN.description: Origin point of the loading plane as [x, y, z].

AXIS_X.description: Point defining the plane local X axis as [x, y, z].

AXIS_Y.description: Point defining the plane local Y axis (on the x-y plane) as [x, y, z].

TOL.description: Tolerance used when selecting elements on/near the loading plane.

SELECT_TYPE.description: Element Selection Type (case-insensitive). ON_PLANE = elements lying on the loading plane, IN_GROUP = elements in a named element group (see ELEM_GROUP).

ELEM_GROUP.description: [SELECT_TYPE=IN_GROUP] Element Group Name whose elements receive the load. Used only when SELECT_TYPE is IN_GROUP.

FACE_NO.description: [ELEM_TYPE=SOLID] Solid face number (1~6) to which the load is applied. Used only for SOLID elements.

LOAD_DIR.description: Load Direction (case-insensitive). NORMAL_PLANE = normal to the loading plane, NORMAL_ELEM = normal to the element, GLOBAL_X / GLOBAL_Y / GLOBAL_Z = global axis directions.

PROJECT_TYPE.description: Projection Type (case-insensitive). NO = no projection, LOAD_DIR = project along the load direction, LOAD_PLANE = project onto the loading plane.

bDEFINE_NODE.description: [ELEM_TYPE=PLATE] Whether nodes define the loading area boundary. Used only for PLATE elements.

CONNECT_NODE.description: [ELEM_TYPE=PLATE] Loading boundary connecting node numbers (up to 15). Used only for PLATE elements when bDEFINE_NODE is true.

DESC.description: Description text for this plane load.
